statement: SDL Switch HIDAPI recognizes full state report 0x30, full state plus MCU report 0x31, simple state report 0x3F, subcommand reply 0x21 and USB command acknowledgement 0x81; enhanced-report hint and input-only mode influence which path it attempts.

applicability.scope: SDL 3.2.0 decoder and hints; no guarantee other SDL versions, kernel interception or physical firmware supports all modes.
